command:
set -eu
echo QD_HASH_START
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
i=0
for p in /factory_peq/tcon_data/QD/*.bin; do
 test -f "$p"
 test ! -L "$p"
 test "$(wc -c < "$p")" = 5242880
 i=$((i+1))
 test "$i" -le 9
 stat -c '%n %s %b' "$p"
 sha256sum "$p"
done
test "$i" = 9
echo QD_HASH_END
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
mode: hash nine observed 5MiB regular files, no firmware API
